business_problem: Enhancing cloud security is a key challenge for data utilization to achieve “VISION 30”
solution_summary: Mitsubishi Tanabe Pharma used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Studio, Microsoft Dynamics 365 to improve secure, governed access to business data and operations. Enhancing cloud security is a key challenge for data utilization to achieve “VISION 30”. Key implementation elements included Azure OpenAI Service generates natural-language responses and task automation for the solution; Azure AI Studio provides the workspace for building, testing, and deploying the AI application; Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; Microsoft Defender provides security controls across the consolidated environment. business_outcome: Generative AI, which can generate a variety of contents using learned data such as images, texts, and program codes, can be expected to improve productivity if utilized well. In this context, Mitsubishi Tanabe Pharma has incorporated Azure OpenAI Service (hereinafter, Azure OpenAI) into its security operations to reduce the time required to check incidents and improve the employee security literacy.
